test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

The captain told the crew that the ship had to reach London that night.

options.text: The captain said to the crew, “The ship had to reach London that night.”
The captain said to the crew, “The ship has to reach London tonight.”
The captain said to the crew, “The ship had reached London tonight.”
The captain said to the crew, “The ship will have to reach London that night.”

solution: The correct answer is **The captain said to the crew, “The ship has to reach London tonight.”** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Direct Speech. • The process of transformation is as follows: • 'told' will be changed into 'said to' because in the given sentence reporting Verb has an 'object'. • Comma and inverted commas will be added. • 'had' will be changed into 'has'. • **'that night'** will be changed into** 'tonight'.** **Correct Sentence:__** *The captain said to the crew, “The ship has to reach London tonight.”* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य Indirect Speech में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Direct Speech में बदलना होगा। • परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है: • 'Told' को 'said to' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि दिए गए वाक्य में **reporting verb** में '**object**' है। • **Comma **और **inverted comma** जोड़े जाएंगे। • 'had' को 'has' में बदल दिया जाएगा। • 'that night' को 'tonight' में बदल दिया जाएगा। e8:T84e, The correct answer is **Overtook by **i.e. **this part has an error.**
